content:
rachel: heads up — QA flagged a keyboard/scan issue in Run History compact mode. when rows render structured tool outputs the screen reader reads a long JSON blob inline and the user loses context. example: "Result: {"invoice": {...}}". any quick wins?

sam: ouch. we should never expose raw JSON as the accessible name. propose: expose a short human-friendly summary as the accessible label and keep the machine output in a toggleable code block that is not part of the initial a11y tree (aria-hidden) until expanded.

maya: agree. also consider role="list" for the run entries and role="listitem" for each card so screen readers can navigate by item count. the label for each item should include: primary title (schema name), result status (success/fail), and tool source. keep it short.

dan: for compact rows we currently show a tiny badge like "amt: $1234" — copy tweak request: make badges sentence-case and prepend context, e.g., "Amount: $1,234". it reads better via TTS.

lisa: accessibility nit: badges also need aria-labels that expand abbreviations. e.g., visually show "Amt" but aria-label "Amount". otherwise screen reader users miss important data.

sam: related UX: when a user filters the run history by tool or schema, the filter chips should be keyboard dismissible and announce the filter name + count. add aria-live for chip removal confirmations.

rachel: good. small dev constraint: we render hundreds of rows, so we can't add heavy DOM for every row. suggestions?

maya: virtualization helps. for a11y, we can maintain an offscreen live region that reflects the focused row details. when keyboard focus moves, update the live region with a short summary (title, status, source). that avoids loading full content into the DOM for every item.

dan: implementation note: live region updates need debouncing or we'll spam SRs when arrowing quickly. 250ms debounce?

lisa: +1 on debounce. also for expanded detail panels ensure focus is moved into the panel when opened and returned on close. keyboard users must be able to escape with ESC.

sam: copy behavior: add an inline "Copy result" button on expanded panels and expose the same via context menu on row. make sure copied text is the cleaned human-readable output, not raw JSON unless user chooses "Copy raw JSON".

rachel: wording suggestion for the copy button: "Copy summary" and secondary "Copy raw JSON". shorter and clearer.

ci-bot: note: branch "run-history-a11y-fixes" created from rachel/run-history. CI running.

maya: plan sounds good. let's split work:
- sam: implement item accessible labels + debounce live region (eta Thu)
- dan: badge copy tweaks and aria-labels for chips (eta Wed)
- lisa: write keyboard interaction spec (focus management + ESC) and sample SR narration strings (eta Wed)
- rachel: integration tests with screen readers (NVDA/VoiceOver) and sample recordings (eta Fri)

sam: i'll skip adding raw JSON to the initial aria tree. will add toggle that sets aria-hidden accordingly and trap focus in expanded panel while open.

rachel: thanks! i'll drop a short design mock that shows the compact row with aria-hidden JSON, live region behavior, and chip states. linking back here when done. :pray:
